task: Edit this in-app rate-limit error message to accurately describe the retry behavior per the supplied facts. Remove the automatic retry claim and the incorrect 5-second interval; state the correct reset timing and that retry is manual.
input: You've hit the rate limit. The app will automatically retry in 5 seconds.

facts.text: The application does not retry automatically.
The rate limit resets 60 seconds after the first request in the current window.
The user must manually retry by activating the Retry button.
The rate limit is 10 requests per minute per account.

forbidden_additions: Automatic retry when the facts specify manual retry.
A 5-second retry interval when the facts specify a 60-second window.
An invented recovery action different from the Retry button.
preserve: Manual retry via the Retry button.
